scope: Reviewed main Performance patches; patch application and runtime power effects remain separate evidence

patches.name: optimized_mem_operations
patches.mechanism: Uses word-sized generic memset/memcpy/memmove loops only where the architecture has no override.
patches.power_review: No clock, idle or thermal policy change. ARM64 architecture routines can make the generic edits unused.

patches.name: reduce_cache_pressure
patches.mechanism: Changes the default vfs_cache_pressure from 100 to 50, retaining dentry/inode cache longer.
patches.power_review: May avoid repeated lookup work while retaining more reclaimable cache; no guaranteed battery effect.

patches.name: mem_opt_prefetch
patches.mechanism: Adds ARM64 L1 streaming prefetch hints to the copy template.
patches.power_review: Can reduce copy latency but prefetching unused data can add memory traffic; workload-dependent.

patches.name: optimise_memcmp
patches.mechanism: Replaces the ARM64 memcmp implementation with a reviewed scalar/SIMD implementation.
patches.power_review: Changes instruction efficiency only; it does not raise frequencies or disable thermal limits.

patches.name: minimise_wakeup_time
patches.mechanism: Bounds the alarmtimer suspend-failure wakeup event near the nearest timer instead of two seconds.
patches.power_review: Intended to avoid excess awake time after this narrow failure path; runtime benefit is unmeasured.

patches.name: int_sqrt
patches.mechanism: Changes the generic integer square-root algorithm.
patches.power_review: No scheduler, frequency, idle or thermal policy change.

patches.name: reduce_gc_thread_sleep_time
patches.mechanism: Reduces only urgent F2FS GC sleep from 500 ms to 50 ms; normal and no-GC sleeps are unchanged.
patches.power_review: Urgent GC can start sooner and do work earlier; it does not schedule GC every 50 ms. Power effect is workload-dependent.

patches.name: add_timeout_wakelocks_globally
patches.mechanism: Turns legacy indefinite pm_wake_lock calls into 500 ms wakeup events.
patches.power_review: Can cut required work short and cause retries or functional failures; not a clean stable power optimization.

patches.name: f2fs_reduce_congestion
patches.mechanism: Reduces the F2FS congestion wait timeout from 20 ms to 6 ms.
patches.power_review: Can retry I/O sooner under congestion; neither reduced energy nor increased drain is guaranteed.

patches.name: reduce_freeze_timeout
patches.mechanism: Reduces the userspace freeze timeout from 20 s to 1 s and makes its sysfs writer a no-op.
patches.power_review: Slow freezes can fail and be retried; the no-op writer also creates false-success risk. Candidate only.

patches.name: clear_page_16bytes_align
patches.mechanism: Aligns the ARM64 clear_page entry to 16 bytes.
patches.power_review: Code-layout change only; no direct clock, idle or thermal policy effect.

patches.name: avoid_extra_s2idle_wake_attempts
patches.mechanism: Calls s2idle_wake only for the first suspend-abort event instead of every event.
patches.power_review: Avoids duplicate wake attempts in this path; suspend correctness still needs physical testing.

patches.name: disable_cache_hot_buddy
patches.mechanism: Disables the scheduler CACHE_HOT_BUDDY feature default.
patches.power_review: Changes migration/locality decisions and can help or hurt cache behavior; no universal power win.

patches.name: f2fs_enlarge_min_fsync_blocks
patches.mechanism: Raises the F2FS minimum fsync block threshold from 8 to 20.
patches.power_review: Changes I/O batching and sync latency trade-offs; energy effect depends on storage workload.

patches.name: increase_ext4_default_commit_age
patches.mechanism: Raises the ext4 journal commit interval from 5 s to 30 s.
patches.power_review: Can batch journal writes but enlarges the potential uncommitted-data window after a crash.

patches.name: increase_sk_mem_packets
patches.mechanism: Raises the default socket packet-memory scale from 256 to 1024.
patches.power_review: Changes buffering and queueing, primarily a memory/network trade-off rather than a direct power control.

patches.name: reduce_pci_pme_wakeups
patches.mechanism: Raises the PCI PME polling workaround interval from 1 s to 4 s.
patches.power_review: Polls less often but can detect relevant PME events later; actual relevance depends on the platform.

patches.name: silence_irq_cpu_logspam
patches.mechanism: Downgrades rate-limited IRQ affinity warnings to debug messages.
patches.power_review: Only logging verbosity changes; diagnostics become less visible without a measured power claim.

patches.name: silence_system_logspam
patches.mechanism: Scans /dev/kmsg reads and suppresses lines containing healthd, logd or dashd.
patches.power_review: Adds substring work and hides diagnostics; not a clean power optimization. Candidate only.
